title: Advanced Marriage - AM
description: Modern Minecraft marriage plugin with shared home, teleport, chest, PvP toggle, and revenge system.
body:
# AdvancedMarriage
A fully customizable marriage and social plugin designed for modern Minecraft servers.

AdvancedMarriage gives server owners complete control over:
*   Interactive management GUIs
*   The PvP Revenge system
*   Cross-server shared inventories
*   Partner teleportation & homes
*   Per-world feature restrictions
*   MiniMessage display formatting

---

# Features

## Couples Viewer GUI
![ui preview](https://media.lyrinth.com/MCplugin-assert/Screenshot%202026-03-08%20041122.png)

Browse server relationships through clean, built-in menus.
*   **Couples List:** A paginated GUI displaying all married couples on the server.
*   Customizable GUI items and interface text.

## The Revenge System
When a player's partner is killed by another player, the survivor can take revenge.
*   **Revenge Window:** Configurable expiration time.
*   **Target Tracking:** Distance trigger warnings when near the killer.
*   **Multi-Tier Buffs:** Grant custom effects (Speed, Strength) when attacking the killer.
*   **Bounty Rewards:** Optional custom commands/rewards for successfully avenging a partner.

## Cross-Server Shared Chest
Each couple receives a secure, private storage inventory.
*   Configurable inventory size.
*   Safely serialized and stored in the database.
*   **Cross-server ready** (works seamlessly across networks using MySQL/MariaDB).

## Advanced Marriage Control
Define how couples interact on your server.
*   Marriage requests with configurable timeouts.
*   Partner online/offline notifications.
*   Divorce cooldowns to prevent abuse.
*   **PvP Toggle:** Prevent accidental damage between partners.

## Homes & Teleportation
*   Set a private **Marriage Home**.
*   Teleport to homes or directly to partners.
*   Configurable teleport countdowns and sound cues.

## Per-World Configuration
Control exactly where features can be used via Whitelist or Blacklist.
Supported filters per world:
*   Teleport
*   Shared Chest
*   Home
*   Revenge
*   Commands

## Database Support
Bundled JDBC drivers mean **zero setup required**. Works instantly with:
*   SQLite (Default)
*   MySQL
*   MariaDB
*   PostgreSQL

## Flexible Message & Audio
*   Full **MiniMessage** support (Hex colors, gradients).
*   Automatic fallback to legacy color codes.
*   Fully configurable sounds for nearly every event (GUI clicks, teleporting, revenge triggers).

## Economy System (Vault / PlayerPoints)
*   Require a configurable fee to send a marriage request.
*   Supports both standard economy and premium points.

---

# Requirements
*   Java 17+
*   Vault (optional, for economy support)
*   PlayerPoints (optional, for point support)
